rdfs:label: SymmetricProperty
rdfs:comment: An OWL property whose inverse is itself — if `A p B`, then `B p A`.
notes: Classic examples: `owl:sameAs`, `owl:differentFrom`, `owl:disjointWith`, `prov:alternateOf`, `skos:related`. Note: `foaf:knows` is deliberately NOT symmetric — knowing someone is not necessarily reciprocated. Use for two-way relations the writer should only need to assert once. Distinct from a property that simply has a separately-named inverse (`hasPart` vs `isPartOf`) — symmetric properties *are* their own inverse.

history.note: Replaced foaf:knows/dcterms:relation (not symmetric) with genuinely symmetric examples; example now skos:related.
